gloss: steadily, rapidly, by leaps and bounds

definitions.gloss: steadily, rapidly, by leaps and bounds
definitions.explanation: Describes continuous, noticeable progress or increase. Emphasizes steady and strong momentum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐんぐん⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐんぐん⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
⟦{売|う}り{上|あ}げ→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐんぐん⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: Sales grew by leaps and bounds.

examples.japanese: ぐんぐん⟦{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}られて→引っ張る：02402_hipparu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。

notes:
ぐんぐん is an onomatopoeic adverb that expresses steady, powerful progress or increase. It conveys a sense of unstoppable momentum.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ぐんぐん⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (grow rapidly)
- ぐんぐん⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧ (extend/grow steadily)
- ぐんぐん⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧/⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧ (rise/fall steadily)
- ぐんぐん⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (advance steadily)

NUANCE: Unlike ⟦{徐々|じょじょ}に→徐々に：04131_jojoni⟧ (gradually), which emphasizes slowness, ぐんぐん emphasizes strength and noticeable speed of change.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どんどん→どんどん：01261_dondon⟧: One after another, rapidly (emphasizes succession)
- ぐんぐん: Steadily, powerfully (emphasizes continuous momentum)
- ⟦めきめき→めきめき：07408_mekimeki⟧: Rapidly improving (often for skills)
